title: skullbase-corridor: local-first finite-instrument corridor exploration in 3D Slicer
description: Research software for local, surgeon-supervised exploration of finite rigid skull-base instrument corridors. This release is not clinically validated and provides no treatment recommendation or safety claim.
notes: Public execution is local-first. The optional Azure deployment is retained only as an engineering benchmark. No clinical validation, safety, efficacy, or approach-superiority claim is made.
